verifiedNote: author: modal + bare infinitive is core grammar; Cambridge Grammar 'Could' (URL not fetched by author; https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/could); Longman 'need' grammar note contrasts needn't + bare inf (https://www.ldoceonline.com/dictionary/need). reminder'ı fiil gibi kullanmadın, değil mi?

noteTr: hatırlatma (isim) = reminder, hatırlatmak (fiil) = remind. 'a' ve sıfattan sonra isim gelir. İki nokta ile 'Just a quick reminder: ...' de doğal.

Variants avoid internal colon because normalizer only strips leading/trailing punctuation.

targetChunk: be dependent on (adj) vs depend on (verb)

noteTr: 'bağımlı/bağlı' sıfatı = dependent (on); fiil = depend on. 'is depend' Türkçe ek-fiil (-dir) etkisi. İsim: dependency.

Don't say: dependent of' (https://www.ldoceonline.com/dictionary/dependent); Cambridge 'dependent on' (https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/dependent). 'seed data' = test/db seeding term, author believes standard; verifier may confirm.
